reader_question: What checks are meant to happen before a temporary GPU lease, and what happens after the work?
dominant_message: Model evidence, a current quote, and owner limits precede paid work; cleanup must be verified.
exact_subtitle: Evidence, live prices and owner limits guide every paid step
method: Code-rendered diagram using Pillow; no image-generation model was used. The reproducible renderer is scripts/render_content_system_asset.py.
text_policy: Short functional labels. The planned-state pill and stop condition are part of the diagram's explanation.
alt_text: A planned five-stage GPU workflow moves from model research to an offer quote, owner-limit checks, bounded work, and verified cleanup; missing evidence or limits stop the flow before creation.
placement: README mechanism section, beside a clear statement of which stages are implemented and which remain planned.
crop_behavior: Keep the complete diagram visible at wide, tablet, and narrow sizes; if it cannot be scaled legibly, link to the full image rather than cropping stages.
rejection_conditions: A stage is shown as shipped without matching code and test evidence.
A crop hides the planned-state marker, any stage, or the stop condition.
A label implies current availability, guaranteed pricing, or unconditional cleanup.
review_decision: Accepted after direct inspection at the full rendered size; labels are legible, the five stages are distinct, and planned behavior is marked.
